advice: Upgrade the Harbormaster at Great Inagua first, since higher-tier upgrades depend on it; it opens after Sequence 04 Mission 01.
Capture all forts early: they give lots of materials and money and open the sea map for Kenway's Fleet.
Send Kenway's Fleet schooners for money and brigs for materials on passive missions.
Open underwater shipwreck chests for money; board Man-o-Wars in hard regions for a captain's lockbox worth roughly 5,500 money each.
If short on materials, use the spyglass to find ships carrying what you need.
Collect the 12 Ultimate Upgrade Plans (6 shipwrecks, 6 treasure maps) for the final upgrade tiers.

Crafting: after reaching Great Inagua (Sequence 04) and buying the Tavern and Harbormaster, buy Fisherman's Wharf for 5,000 Reales so each harpoon yields 2 skins instead of 1; upgrade harpoon gear at the Harbormaster to reach harder harpoon spots; spare skins can be sold.
